_why_this_file_exists: SG-1 C3. Every action in the chapter was free: taking all of them cost nothing and foreclosed nothing, so a participant who inspected everything was strictly better off than one who chose, and there was no choosing. A capability is what an act can commit.
_why_there_are_no_numbers: Canon names time, trust, workload, service capacity and evidence as this world's currencies and sets no prices for any of them. A quantity invites optimisation, which is the behaviour this product exists to make harder. A capability is a NAMED HOLDER IN A NAMED STATE, and its constraint is exclusivity: a holder can be in one place doing one thing. That survives the removal of every clock, which is why the non-timed accessibility path carries the same trade-off rather than a relaxed one.

capabilities.available_state: The roster safely covers about 28 of the 30 occupied ICU beds, and the two physically empty beds have no complete bedside team. Hand ventilation is safe only while competent people can sustain it and monitor the patient. Nour can find enough competent hands to hold the affected bay, and no more.
